answer: Max-flow vouch graphs deter Sybils by routing bounded endorsement capacity from trusted seed keys held in an offline vault. Agents sign capacity-capped peer links, and a verifier admits a candidate only when flow from the seeds meets a threshold. Because edges inside a clone cluster cannot widen the cut to honest peers, attackers must win scarce endorsement budget per fake identity. However, sparse nodes, such as a sensor on a remote jetty during a gale, risk false rejection.
